articleTitle: An exploration of Hospital Management Innovation with patient perceived value: Based on the study in Taizhou Hospital of Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Under the guidance of a certain innovation target, Hospital Management Innovation (HMI) is a process of improving medical service quality by changing the management functions and administrative tasks, which thereby can improve the patient experience during medical treatment. Bearing task reconstruction and patient value improvement in mind, Taizhou Hospital did a practice of HMI which based on the theory of patient perceived value. This practice is a success and has provided an important reference for other hospitals to enhance the level of hospital management and improve the quality of medical services.

articleTitle: On knowledge management in higher education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Universities are important carriers for knowledge production, dissemination, and innovation. They play an important role in the development of knowledge society. This paper, based on the concept of knowledge management, puts forward suggestions to establish hardware platform and to improve hardware facilities in the implementation of knowledge management, to create a good environment to support knowledge exchange, to encourage the full participation of teachers and students in knowledge transfer and to accelerate knowledge innovation.

articleTitle: Risk of social disruption and integration function development of news products of traditional media in the digital age
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Traditional media are now facing a great challenge from digital media, especially the Internet, so the survival and development of traditional media and the innovation of the traditional media's products, especially news products, in the digital age have become hot issues. Based on the theory of the gratification-utility niche, the relationships between traditional media and new media include “time displacement” and “functional displacement”. So when the emergence and development of new digital media has brought about the scientific and technological progress, as well as the significant transformation of social structure in which some social risks, such as social disruption also appeared, we could to develop the integration function of news products of traditional media in order to overcome the risk of social disruption and avoid the displacement of traditional media by digital media. And this paper proposes that the production and effects of social integration function of news products can be realized in two ways: providing the non-choice news to share common experience, and expressing mainstream values through agenda setting to guide public opinion.

articleTitle: Consumer adoption of mobile advertising: An empirical investigation among China users
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Mobile advertising offer great opportunities for enterprises. Understanding user adoption of mobile advertising become important in explaining mobile advertising growing at an exponential rate in these years. The purpose of this study was to analyze factors possibly affecting user adoption of mobile advertising. This paper proposed a model for analyzing mobile advertising adoption of Chinese users. The analysis is based on a consumer survey. This paper tests the proposed model through a questionnaire survey involving 298 mobile phone users in China. The results indicate consumer attitude is mainly affected by Perceived usefulness and Perceived ease of use. It is also found that Perceived usefulness, subjective norm and consumer attitude are vital for consumer adoption. The findings provide useful suggestions and implications for academics and businesses.

articleTitle: Conceptual model of tacit knowledge transfer within organizations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Tacit knowledge which exists in employees' mind, and is difficult to be formalized and imitated, is the source of enterprises' competitive advantages. On the basis of analyzing characteristics of tacit knowledge, transfer subject and influencing factor of knowledge transfer, this paper establishes a conceptual model of tacit knowledge transfer within organizations, based on which, some effective approaches to improve tacit knowledge transfer are given.

articleTitle: Cloud-based innovation of Internet long tail
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Cloud computing has been considered as a significant change, especially to the so-called “long tail” in the Internet industry, which targets at a niche market. This paper focuses on the innovation of Internet long tail in the cloud environment. For this purpose, it systematically analyzes and summarizes the influence of cloud computing on innovation and how to seize these opportunities for Internet long tail. The result reveals that Cloud computing has brought unprecedented innovative opportunities for Internet long tail to access to the markets monopolized by big corporations, making the long tail more valuable to meet the various demand.

articleTitle: The research on Commercial Banks' product innovations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: In recent years, affected by the product innovations from foreign Commercial Banks and the needs of financial reforms and developments, China's Commercial Banks make their dominant positions in the financial sectors. The traditional functions increasingly consolidate because they actively participate in the financial product innovation activities. This research introduces the product innovations in three parts: First, introduce the general ideas on Commercial Banks' product innovations; Second, introduce the direction of commercial bank product innovation, this part introduce in aspects of preference, interactions of products, efficiency, advantages, model; Last, introduce the key points on commercial banking product innovation, this part introduce in aspects of asset, debt, the intermediary business. Then we draw a conclusion: Commercial Banks must set up the flexible management idea and take the market as the guidance. According to the demand of the inherent regularity, create demand and guide demand.

The thesis proposes KM-SM model, the sport event management based upon knowledge management, which is new and original to promote the managing proficiency of event organization.

articleTitle: Empirical study on Chinese car enterprise upgrading based on global value chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Entering the 21th century, international division of labor undergoes profound changes. In global value chain, the developed countries always occupy the parts with high added value while the developing countries mainly take on simple and low value-added manufacturing activities. And it is the true reflection of Chinese car industry. Thinking out getting rid of the low position in global value chain by enterprise upgrading is driven both by the restriction of resource and internal choice of Chinese car enterprises. For Chinese car enterprise upgrading, this paper proposes a theoretic analysis framework by combining external and internal factors and makes empirical study on the framework based on Chinese regional panel data. Besides, by analyzing two typical car enterprises, this paper also makes empirical study on the status quo of Chinese car enterprise upgrading.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: The roles of innovation in the industrial park's operating mechanism has changed with the change of government's policy, market environment and competitive pressure, and it become the factor that may decide whether the industrial park can develop in a sustainable way. The concept of regional innovation provides a good reference for the innovative thoughts in the industrial park's development. In order to achieve rational resource allocation and efficiency of the continuous upgrading, industrial park promote its progress by internal innovation and external innovation. This paper try to analyze the role of innovation in the industrial park's development by environment analysis, inputs factors, the internal operation, innovative outputs and effects evaluation.

articleTitle: Analysis of actual value of foreign investment and Wuhan Regional Technical Innovation Ability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: In this paper, the author uses Cointegration theory, Granger causality test reseach on relationship between the actual value of foreign investment in Wuhan and regional technological innovation capability, and found that: (1) In the long run, Wuhan actual use of foreign investment and technological innovation in the region between the region have a greater positive correlation; (2) Granger causality test shows that the actual use of foreign investment Wuhan Regional Technical Innovation Ability The Granger cause. And in this conclusion on the basis of policy recommendations.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern service industry, it is essential to research on innovation of the tourism service based on modern information technology. On the basis of analysis of drive factors, this paper presents a new concept of tourism services, namely the Tourism Services3.0, that is, main concept of interaction between tourists and tourism service providers, based on"Web3.0"technologies and service platforms. The article also details in the applications and processes of tourism services 3.0.

articleTitle: Research on the transmission mechanism of enterprises financial risk
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: This paper defines concepts of financial risk and financial risk transmission, analyzes risk source, risk flows, risk carriers and risk thresholds of enterprises financial risk transmission. Then this paper analyzes the transmission pathway of enterprise financial risk from three aspects of capital chain, business process chain and value chain, which is a theoretical foundation of prevention and control of enterprises financial risk.

articleTitle: Based on the analysis of foreign oil company the construction of Sinopec technology innovation system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: With using a comparative analysis method, this paper put forward a technology innovation system of oil industry in the current international prevailing. The internationalization and integration are the constant trend. On the basis of extensive investigation and detailed analysis of the technical innovation system of Stumberger, baker Hughes and Halliburton, and using this as reference, this paper constructs a technical innovation system of Sinopec. It has three levels and nine and layers of technology innovation system, and there are two characteristic of internationalization and integration. Meanwhile this paper would provide the beneficial reference for the technical innovation system of Chinese petroleum engineering company.

articleTitle: The cold chain logistics performance evaluation on sideline products based on data envelopment analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Our country agricultural and sideline products circulation is very large, of which more than 80% of the sideline products is taken to storage at room temperature, circulation and primary processing methods, and post-flow loss rate of 25%-30%. Inefficient agricultural logistics is becoming a huge obstacle for the process of agricultural industrialization and agricultural development in the distribution industry. In this paper, we use the food cold chain logistics theory, performance management theory and other subjects of the theory, first described the necessary and the basic principles for construction of the sideline cold chain logistics service performance evaluation system, and then we build index system of sideline products cold chain logistics' performance evaluation from three dimensions, including industry environment, resource and environment, risk management. On this basis, with data envelopment analysis (DEA), taking Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Hubei, Henan, Hunan six middle provinces and cities as samples, analysis and evaluate sideline cold chain logistics service performance in these Province, to provide reference for government departments to plan and manage cold-chain logistics service system.

articleTitle: Research on coupling mechanism of the enterprise's technology management competence and network competence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Both technology management competence and network competence have a significant positive impact on an enterprise's innovation success. This paper analyzes the coupling relationship of technology management competence and network competence, builds the coupling degree evaluation index system of the two competences, and then sets up the coupling degree evaluation model based on physical theory. Finally, the model is used to evaluate the coupling degree of M corporation's technology management competence and network competence, and the results show that M corporation's technology management competence and network competence are at the middle coupling level.

abstract: Theory of enterprise life cycle has been mature since its initiation by Haire in 1959. Weight determination of the evaluative indicators in survival stage is used as an example to introduce fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Based on a clear understanding of current enterprise strategy, this paper lays the foundation for enterprises' strategic transformation and reform.

articleTitle: The exploratory analysis of effective factors of safety management performance of Air Traffic Control team
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Safety Management Performance of Air Traffic Control is affected by many factors. Via questionnaire statistics analysis and Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) to optimize items and extract factors, the authors confirm five main effective factors at last, including work initiative, communication and exchange, team cohesion, system completeness and leadership management, and all of them have passed the reliability test and validity test so as to enhance the level of safety management of Air Traffic Control.

articleTitle: The study of customer knowledge absorptive capacity on core competence of our accounting firms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: With the deepening of reform and opening up, Chinese modern accounting services had been received constantly development; however, in order to occupy the “limited” domestic market, the Chinese accounting firms should choose some new angles to construct their competitive advantage. This paper would like to focus on absorbing the customer knowledge's point to study on how to construct the accounting firms' core competitiveness. We proposed a conceptual model and some research hypotheses based on the literatures done by other scholars. And we collect data by the questionnaires and testify the model by the SEM (Structural Equation Modeling). The research results showed that our accounting firms' abilities of understanding and using were directly influence the construction of the core competition, but the other two abilities had indirectly impact. The results were conformed with the working requirements and development direction of State Ministry of Finance, Certified Public Accountants Association and Chinese accounting firms. We believe our accounting firms might consider raising their abilities of understanding and using customer knowledge to construct the core competitiveness.

articleTitle: Game analysis of China's telecom industry in the process of telecommunication infrastructure sharing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: This It is a basic trend and fundamental requirement that the telecommunication infrastructure construction needs joint forces so as to share resources for better results. This paper studies the background of promoting the construction of telecommunication infrastructure in China and concludes the status quo and existing problems of the joint efforts and sharing of telecommunication infrastructure construction at the current stage. As a result, according to game analysis of China's telecom industry in the process of telecommunication infrastructure sharing which based on the situation of 3G network construction, the author proposes corresponding countermeasures and proposals to accelerate the construction process of telecommunication infrastructure sharing from the aspect of resources allocation, cooperation and competition, governmental regulations, developmental patterns, and stakeholders, etc.

Application examples indicated that this model overcome the defects of qualitative evaluation, whose subjectivity was too strong, and possessed good rationality and validity, thus it made a practical tool to evaluate law firm's knowledge management performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of elements in the conduction of financial strategic risk
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Business financial strategy includes funding strategy, investment strategy, and income distribution strategy. Because different financial strategies are interrelated and mutually influenced, the conduction of financial strategic risk is objective and complex. Firstly, this paper introduces the definition of the conduction of financial strategic risk, then analyzes three elements in the conduction: risk sources, the vector of conduction and the fuse of conduction. In the conduction of financial strategic risk, the various uncertain factors of internal and external environment are risk sources of financial strategic risk, cash flow is the vector of financial strategic risk's conduction, and threshold mutation is the fuse in the conduction of financial strategic risk.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: This paper tried to use visualizing tools to show the citation analysis field clearly. We selected “knowledge creation” and “innovation” as search words and 248 records of articles and reviews in 1998-2011 was retrieved from the Web of Science. Then we got the knowledge maps by studying the dataset with RCA (Reference Co-Citation Analysis) and CA (Cluster Analysis). These maps could reflect the development trend of the research about the relationship of innovation and knowledge creation. Results shown, the theory of knowledge creation provides a unique research perspective for innovation; Knowledge management and Product development were the research focus; the conversion of knowledge has a significant effect on technological innovation.

abstract: In recent years, local governments in China pay more and more attention to regional competitiveness for they begin to take the responsibility of developing local economy. The other hand, innovative industrial cluster can promote the regional competitiveness. Therefore, the study of relationships between regional competitiveness and innovative industrial cluster has become an important issue. The main purpose of this paper is to research on the interactional relationship between regional competitiveness and innovative industrial cluster. Innovative industrial cluster is the main path for the promotion of the regional competitiveness. Regional competitiveness gives impetus to the development of innovative industrial cluster.

articleTitle: The empirical research on the performance of stock options incentive
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: The issue of the separation of ownership from control and the alignment of management and shareholder via the managerial ownership of equity remain the key topic of Chinese listed companies. Through the empirical study, this paper reveals that the managerial shareholding has no effect on management performance. The fundamental resolution to get the stock option incentive work in China is to set up a reasonable ownership structure and an effective capital market.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain contract design under information-sharing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: In this paper, a two-stage supply chain was used as the object to analyze the changes of supply chain efficiency and effectiveness before and after information sharing, while the influence of the shortage cost was considered. Based on cooperative game of the two sides after information sharing, the supply chain contract systems and its contract parameter design models were provided for enterprises to practice easily. This study shows that after information sharing, the supplier can use supply chain contracts to improve the supply chain efficiency and effectiveness, and increase the profits of the partners; if the two sides share the inventory risk costs, the combinations of the inventory transfer price and the inventory risk cost coefficient shared by the supplier must satisfy a condition to ensure that the profit combination of the supply chain is a Pareto improvement; if the two sides share the costs and profits, the supplier can use the Rubinstein model to determine the profit sharing coefficient, and improve the efficiency of contract design.

articleTitle: Multi-generation diffusion: An empirical analysis of Earth Resource Satellite
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Earth Resource Satellite (ERS) data product has played such a more and more important role in many industries that it is necessary to master the rule governing the diffusion of ERS data product. The current research has done little on multi-generation diffusion of ERS data product. This paper applied multi-generation diffusion theory to do some try on this topic. We build three models and use users data of three generations of China Brazil Earth Resources Satellite(CBERS) data product to fit them and then select the optimal model. With the selected model, we analyze how the diffusion parameters change across generations and users transformation across generations. The analysis results show that the user usurped from previous generations, especially from China Brazil Earth Resources Satellite 02(CBERS-02), constitute majority of users of China Brazil Earth Resources Satellite 02B (CBERS-02B)data product. Based on this conclusion, this paper put forward related recommendations to promote the diffusion of ERS data product.

articleTitle: Research on chaos synchronization of bullwhip effect in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: We believe that supply chain is a complex and nonlinear system in which chaos is in general prevalent. This paper models the supply chain management with a proposed tri-echelon theoretical framework, showing that it can be transformed into Lorenz equation of state under certain conditions and chaos arises. This article moves one step deeper into the causes and negative impacts of bullwhip effect in a supply chain chaos system. The Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network parameter - training approach is utilized to dampen bullwhip effect and the methodology is presented for the design of chaos synchronization controller in this article. Simulation test demonstrates that this methodology is effective in that it helps reduce and mitigate bullwhip effect and provide additional insights into theory and practice.

articleTitle: An empirical research on motivation conduction between organizational system and knowledge transfer performance based on mediating effect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: The knowledge is the source of the competitive advantage and knowledge creation in knowledge-based economy. However, the knowledge transfer is directly under the control of the transfer will and the ability of the knowledge individual. Therefore, if the organizations want to carry out effectively the knowledge transfer, they have to make out the effective incentive mechanism and measures. If they want to make out the effectively motivation measures, they have to identify the relevant factors and their mutual function in the knowledge transfer firstly. Based on above, the paper firstly put forward the necessity of the motivation conduction in the knowledge transfer. Secondly, the paper pointed out the definition and the relevant hypothesies of the motivation conduction in the organizational knowledge transfer. Thirdly, the paper designed the relevant statistic variables of the motivation conduction in the knowledge transfer. Fourthly, the paper carried out the questionnaire investigation amd the statistic analysis on the motivation conduction in the knowledge transfer. Finally, the paper concluded the empirial research and got the relevant conclusions of the motivation conduction.

articleTitle: “Enshi, a dwelling place of fairy” and revival and exploitation of the stilted building architecture brand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: This paper begins with four aspects: the disappearing “ dwelling place of the Fairy”, the covered living fossil, coexistence and mutualistic symbiosis, as well as its revival and exploitation, focuses on expounding “Enshi as a dwelling place of fairy” and how to revive and exploit the Stilted Building (DiaoJiao Lou). Culture is the connotation of building up Enshi as “a dwelling place of fairy”, and to build up “ dwelling place of fairy” is the base for rival of Stilted Buildings architecture of Tujia nationality. At the same time, to revive and exploit the Stilted Building is one of the important components of development of Enshi. Therefore, giving full play to the advantage of geographical feature and displaying its brand effect will be an ideal approach of constructing Enshi as “a dwelling place of fairy” which gives connotation to ecotourism culture.

articleTitle: System analysis of IT-construction, organizational learning and commercial bank operational risk control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: In the banking industry the operational risks have been the most important risks, which have made operational risk control become an important area of commercial bank risks control in China. In two decades, banking information construction has made great achievements in China's financial sector, and organizational learning has also effectively promoted China's commercial bank management level. IT construction and organizational learning must be a natural boost on commercial bank operational risk control. For illustration, 500 questionnaires were recycled and the full model method of structural equation model was used. Six latent variable composite reliability were greater than 0.7, and the cumulative explanation quantity of factor analysis were greater than 0.5. The fit index values were located in the standard range, and the theoretical model fitted well, which can be used to test the hypothesis. The empirical research has revealed that China's commercial banks IT-construction and organizational learning have integrated functions in improving the operational risk control performance.

abstract: The inspection results of VECM model being aimed at China's human capital level and FDI technology spillover from 1985 to 2009 show that there is a long-term stable relationship between them. Further analysis shows that FDI voluntary technology spillover promotes level of China's human capital, the overall low level and the less increment of human capital could not accelerate FDI compulsory technology spillover in which the weak influence of human capital on FDI technology spillover is revealed. Based on the above analysis, recommendations are put forward that the policy involved FDI introduction should lean on potential FDI which has more possibility of technology spillover, and secondary education input should be continuously reinforced.

abstract: Based on the basic concept of Innovative Enterprise Knowledge Management(IEKM), and its structural dimension of knowledge innovation, assimilation, application and protection, this paper builds a four-dimensional model of the innovative enterprise knowledge management maturity. By questionnaire survey and the analytic hierarchy process, this paper obtains the maturity of innovative enterprises and proposes the skip-level path of IEKM's maturity.

articleTitle: Cloud entrepreneurial platform: A new entrepreneurial assistant organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: This paper references the idea of "cloud computing", putting forward a new entrepreneurial assistant organization-cloud entrepreneurial platform. After defining its meaning, this paper analyses its advantages by using economic theories, and at last analyses its elements. As a better resource organization than traditional one, the model of cloud entrepreneurial platform not only pushes significant changes in entrepreneurial process, but also makes a great impact on organization and individual in it, and promotes a formation of more open and healthier life system. And also, it will improve the social rate in the whole social respect.

articleTitle: Research on applying the internet to innovate on products of China's travel agencies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and tourism, the internet has become an important means of innovation on products of China's travel agencies. There is a great space for China's travel agencies to apply the internet to carry out the innovation on their products. Comparing with the developed countries, the development and design conception of China's travel agencies lag behind, and their tourist products are crude and lack personalities, thus have restricted the development of China's travel agencies seriously. Aiming at these problems, this paper adopts the methods of induction and systems analysis, has analyzed the significance and existing problems for China's travel agencies to innovate on tourist products by applying the internet, and proposed some innovative strategies. Finally, such a conclusion has been reached: as long as China's travel agencies recognize fully the significance of using the internet, adopt some necessary measures, applying the internet to better and innovate on their products continuously, then China's travel agencies will certainly improve their international competitiveness and get a healthy development.

abstract: The article depicts the features of project management mechanism and the application of publishing and sums up constituent system and evaluation system of project management mechanism in publishing, combining the development and trends of modern publishing. It divides project management system of publishing into five systems: topic-aiming control system, quality management control system, talent management control system, investment management control system and benefit management control system. In the article, the author not only analyses its concrete integration in detail, but also points out how publishing applies a series of mechanisms to improve efficiency as well as enterprise competition. In the end, the author, combining publishing's development of digital era, comes up with that under this background, publishing should introduce project management mechanism as early to adopt new competitive environment.

articleTitle: On innovative management of China's excessive foreign exchange reserves
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: China's foreign exchange reserves exceeded 3000 billion dollars by the end of March, 2011. What disadvantages do huge, fast growing foreign exchange reserves have? What is the relationship between foreign exchange reserves, CPI and imbalanced income? This paper studies into the relationship between foreign exchange reserves and economic disequilibrium, using Eviews, the result of which shows that both CPI and average disposable income have positive correlation with foreign exchange reserves. Based on analysis of its evolving mechanism, suggestions for creative management of excessive foreign exchange reserves are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on mode analysis of energy-saving building modular development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: In order to further develop energy-saving building with Chinese characteristics, we propose a new mode and method: energy-saving building development. Based on the definition of this development, the paper explores the concept, content and development principles, especially development mode. We use Logistic theory to research the development track, sustainability and approach to realize sustainability. Several conclusions are drawn: Sustainable principle is the most basic and important principle which the energy-saving building modular development should comply with; To achieve the sustainable development, we must take the social and economic develop, resources, environment and technology account for sustainable development.

articleTitle: The evaluation on social-eco-efficiency on industrial enterprises of Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: In the twenty-first century, with the continued environmental awareness and corporate social responsibility extended, it will be the inevitable choice for the industrial enterprises to take systematic development view and implement coordinated and balanced development of the economic - social - ecological aspects. Being both a process of the material metabolism and a social organization, industrial enterprise not only has to pursue productivity and investment efficiency, but also to consider the issue of sustainable development and social harmonious. Industrial enterprise and its external natural, economic and social environment construct a complex ecosystem. It creates not only good outputs including economic products, employment opportunities and stakeholders' appreciation, but also bad outputs such as ecological destruction, environmental pollution and. poverty. In order to realize the sustainable development and harmonious of the economic, social and ecological complex system of industrial enterprises in Guangdong Province, this paper explores the social-eco-efficiency of industrial enterprises theoretically and practically, then evaluate the social-eco-efficiency of industrial enterprises in Guangdong Province.

articleTitle: Market structure, technological innovation and industrial competitive advantage: Policy choices for catching up
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: As for the relationship between market structure and technological innovation, it is an old industrial organizational paradigm. But most of the theories were developed under the context of developed countries and concerned mostly in the relationship between market structure and innovation. Therefore this paper tries to analyze the relationship among market structure, technological innovation and industrial competitive advantage by analyzing the practice of the industrial development of developing countries and is going to offer a theory for the policy makers of late comers. In this paper, two paths for catching up countries are putted forward and simulations are conducted by a dynamic model.

articleTitle: The heterogeneous enterprises and export of textile industry based on exchange rate flexibility
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: With the global economy recovery, exports of Chinese enterprises gradually recover after the trough in the sub-prime crisis. However, the huge trade surplus of china suffered with the US-led developed countries' pressure to an unprecedented rate. Based on the basic theory of elasticity, with the combination of empirical research, on the basis of textile industry exports, the discourse put forward a reasonable range of the RMB exchange rate index and holds the view that the appreciation of the RMB exchange rate has nothing to do with the huge trade surpluses. On this premise, the article construct the core competitive model of textile export heterogeneity of enterprise, explore development ideas of China's textile industry, and come to the acceptability and availability of the RMB exchange rate fluctuations; It can be concluded that the development fundamental of export enterprises of the heterogeneity is to introduce scientific management organizational model, change management concepts and methods of production, subdivision market and enhance the core competitiveness.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: Low-cost competitive is not only the theory choice of China's economic development, but also the practical needs of enterprise management, even more as the important source of booming manufacturing sector. Facing on the normalization of labor cost, resource price, enterprise profit and the requirement of changing the economic development model in China, different level should choice different measures. The Government must choose low-cost, recycling economy development model of economic restructuring measures in macroscopically level. Industry must to achieve the development path of value chain in middle level. Companies must maintain a cost advantage, to further tap the third profit source in microcosmic level.

articleTitle: Research on promoting transportation administrative law enforcement team building
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Product Innovation Management (ICPIM 2011)
abstract: With the arrival of the critical period of reform and development, profound changes are taking place in economic system, social institutions, the pattern of interests and ideas in China. Facing the new and complex situation, particularly the impact on the transport brought by the oil price and tax reform, law enforcement agencies, personnel, funding channels, and development pattern in transportation chief law enforcement ranks also face unprecedented opportunities and challenges. Based on the national survey results, this essay will introduce the construction situation and status of traffic law enforcement in China, deeply analyze and reflect the main problems and causes, and put out ideas for our future transport administrative law enforcement team building through specific measures and suggestions.
